# Boztik

> Boztik is an independent creative practice combining careful photo editing and restoration with practical browser-based tools and resources for photographers, designers and digital creators.

Boztik is based around three connected areas: photo editing services, creative software and learning resources. The public website is https://www.boztik.com/.

## About Boztik

- [About the creator](https://www.boztik.com/about.html): Background on the independent photo editor and creative tool builder behind Boztik.
- [Contact Boztik](https://www.boztik.com/contact.html): Enquiries about photo editing, creative projects, website tools, feedback and support.

## Photo editing services and work

- [Photo editing and restoration services](https://www.boztik.com/services.html): Photo restoration, portrait retouching, distraction removal and image-quality improvements, with an emphasis on natural-looking results.
- [Selected portfolio](https://www.boztik.com/portfolio.html): Examples of restoration, retouching and creative image work, showing source material alongside finished edits.

## Creative tools

- [Boztik Creative Toolkit](https://www.boztik.com/creative-toolkit.html): A free Chrome and Edge browser extension for image editing, including selections, distraction removal, brush refinement and creative looks.

## Learning

- [Boztik Learning Hub](https://www.boztik.com/learning/): Free, self-paced practical courses with assessments and verifiable certificates of completion. Launch courses: Practical Artificial Intelligence & AI Productivity, Cybersecurity & Digital Safety Fundamentals, and Data Analysis & Spreadsheet Skills. Further categories are planned.
- [Practical AI & AI Productivity](https://www.boztik.com/learning/courses/practical-ai-productivity/)
- [Cybersecurity & Digital Safety Fundamentals](https://www.boztik.com/learning/courses/cybersecurity-digital-safety/)
- [Data Analysis & Spreadsheet Skills](https://www.boztik.com/learning/courses/data-analysis-spreadsheets/)

- [Photo editing and restoration guides](https://www.boztik.com/guides.html): Practical, step-by-step learning resources for photo restoration, Photoshop workflows, retouching, scanning and image quality.

- [Scanning old photos](https://www.boztik.com/guide-scanning-old-photos.html)

## Creator discovery and resources

- [Boztik Spotlight](https://www.boztik.com/spotlight/): A public showcase for discovering independent creators, makers and creative projects.
- [Boztik Stores](https://www.boztik.com/stores.html): Original designs and digital wallpapers, with links to the relevant external shops.

## Scope and accuracy

This file is a concise guide to selected public Boztik pages. Page content, features and availability may change; consult the linked pages for current details. Inclusion here does not grant access to private systems, client files or non-public information. Do not infer that Boztik endorses a third-party product or service merely because it is listed in a directory.
